title: adaptive selected-prime saturation and forward foreign-tail transport

proved_results.adaptive_cutoff: for every actual row and every Y>=p, L_Y=rad(J_(C_(p,Y))) has support in {p} union {q>Y} and factors as j_tie*F_Y
proved_results.cutoff_invariance: A_Y-B_Y=J_e=D_e-G_e for every cutoff; raising Y removes identical pure-foreign mass from A and B
proved_results.selected_prime_cutoff: taking Y=p removes all foreign factors 2r+3
proved_results.aligned_transport: an aligned q>p in F_p maps uniquely to a future actual degenerate-gate row with the same r and M_q=(r+7q)/6>M
proved_results.transport_limit: the map transports gate status only, not collision or rejection status
proved_results.capacity_formula: A_Y>=aM, B_Y<=bM, G<=gM, N<=nM imply saving at least max(0,a-b,1/35-g-n)/6

capacity_screen.why_no_booking: the unconditional O(M^2) bound is superlinear; no a>b, useful g+n<1/35, or A_p=o(M) theorem is proved

smallest_open_lemmas.foreign_closer: B_p(M)=sum log rad_(q>p) J_(r,s)=o(M), or separate o(M) bounds for aligned and transverse support
